name: How do I add storage without making the bathroom feel smaller?

mainEntity.name: How do I add storage in a bathroom layout change without making the room feel smaller?
mainEntity.text: How do I add storage in a bathroom layout change without making the room feel smaller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storage is often the missing piece in a layout change, but adding too much of it can make a small bathroom feel cramped. The smartest approach is to use the wall area efficiently rather than filling the room with deep cabinets. Recessed medicine cabinets, shower niches, mirrored storage, and taller but shallower cabinetry can create useful storage without sacrificing circulation. Floating vanities can also help a room look larger by keeping more floor visible. Before adding storage, check how the doors open and whether drawers will interfere with the toilet, shower, or entry. A good layout balances storage with breathing room so the bathroom feels organized rather than overloaded.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use vertical storage, recessed niches, floating vanities, and medicine cabinets instead of bulky cabinets that take up floor space. Good bathroom storage should improve function without narrowing the walkway or crowding the fixtures.
